pages.text: Each car has five parts, from 100% down to 0%:$(li)$(l)Oil$(): an oil change every 50,000 blocks or so$(li)$(l)Engine$(): slowly, and in hard crashes$(li)$(l)Tires$(): by distance, faster off-road$(li)$(l)Brakes$(): every stop$(li)$(l)Body$(): crashes

Worn parts make a car slower, thirstier and slower to stop. The dashboard's warning lights turn amber, then orange, and flash red when a part is gone: at 0% the car $(4)breaks down$() and won't run until it's repaired. Cars are never destroyed.$(br2)Trailers wear their tires, brakes and body too. Electric cars have no oil.
